security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI sets mseccfg.MML=1 (to enable ePMP) without first creating M-mode-only PMP rules covering its own .text/.data/.stack regions. After MML is set, norm:mseccfg_mml_X_restrict prohibits adding new executable M-mode-only rules (pmpcfg writes are silently ignored), and norm:mseccfg_mml_exec_code denies M-mode execution from any region without a matching M-mode-only or locked Shared-Region rule. OpenSBI immediately traps on the next instruction fetch.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: CSR write to mseccfg setting MML bit before PMP entries covering M-mode code/data are configured with L=1 and X permission
security_spec.summary: Setting mseccfg.MML before establishing M-mode-only PMP rules for firmware code causes immediate execution denial (norm:mseccfg_mml_exec_code + norm:mseccfg_mml_X_restrict)
